description: This Java source file defines the 'CommandQueue' class, which manages a singleton queue system for sending commands and handling their confirmations in a serial communication context. It includes mechanisms for retrying commands until confirmed, listening for command responses, and managing command timeouts, particularly distinguishing slow commands.
published: CommandQueue.write(String command, int timeoutMs, InvocationConfirmationListener listener)

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing a queue of commands that are sent repeatedly until a confirmation response is received, with support for different command timeouts and event listeners.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a command queue listener to receive command events.

methods.name: sendPendingCommand
methods.description: Blocks until there is a command to send, then sends it.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command repeatedly until a confirmation message is received.

methods.name: handleConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages to identify and record command confirmations.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the appropriate timeout value depending on whether the command is considered slow.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Enqueues a command for sending, with optional custom timeout and confirmation listener.
